name: Paris
notes:
LitArbi 0.9.32-beta “Paris” (build 34) — shared matters on the LitArbi Server, end-to-end encryption, per-user install.
• New: share a matter with your team on your firm's LitArbi Server (Settings → LitArbi Server). It adds two-step sign-in; Share, Invite and Members; Open Shared and Join a Shared Matter; the ‘On the LitArbi Server’ list in the matter overview; a cloud per exhibit; and a sync status line. It uses the same server and data as the Mac.
• Shared matters are end-to-end encrypted, with keys, invitation codes and a firm recovery key. The server never sees your documents.
• Exhibit numbering is locked while someone else renumbers. Restoring a backup over a shared matter is refused.
• The licence window is redesigned. Invited guests can join another firm's matter free as a guest.
• About shows the version, build, x64/ARM64, the Windows version and the licence holder, with Copy Details.
• LitArbi now installs into your user profile. It needs no administrator rights and works with roaming profiles. An older install under Program Files is removed.
• Setup offers to close Word and retry when installing the Word add-in.
• Build 33: LibreOffice Writer add-in.
